verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM's own documented deployment options let users decide where their data lives. It can run entirely on-device with no data leaving the machine, be self-hosted on the user's own infrastructure, or be deployed on-premise. This gives residency control by deployment choice, but there is no evidence of choosing a storage region for the vendor-hosted offering. Missing for 10: region selection for the hosted cloud instance, explicit data-residency documentation, independent corroboration of residency guarantees.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
